gate: Unchanged earlier gate: OFF arrivals only, all positive ALLN nt!=unclear to all 686 ALPN, 11069 edges (ACh 10944 + octopamine 125). Readout is four PN; gate targets are not narrowed to four.
no_other_changes: No TRN gate or interpretation, no ORN gate stacking, no new adaptation, no live readout implementation.

metrics.peaks: maximum rolling 10/50 ms average wholly inside ON; stride 1 ms
metrics.quiet_tail: also record all four cells after OFF1 and the last spike time; do not equate a mean with silence

criteria.peak_comparators: first vs paired control first; second vs paired control second and vs own first (both reported)
criteria.exact_zero: report each cell separately and counts after OFF1; distinct from <=3Hz reference

threshold_provenance: peak >=70% from prior user criterion; late>=30% and quiet<=3Hz are the prior operational reference from brain-split-std; retain continuous values and exact-zero flags.
pilot: first seed/gain1 control then known_positive; freeze after validation, expand unchanged to remaining 7 pairs
